items.front: The four Vedas and what each is?
Which two works did Yajnavalkya author?
items.back: Shatapatha Brahmana (Yajurveda) and the Brihadaranyaka Upanishad.
items.examPoint: Later Vedic authors — Yajnavalkya, Mahidasa Aitareya, Tittiri

items.back: Kapila — Samkhya Sutras (Samkhya school); Manu — Manusmriti (Dharma/law).
Monk Nagasena answers King Milinda (Menander I); a Pali Buddhist dialogue.

items.front: Match Buddhist authors: Buddhacharita, Visuddhimagga, Abhidharmakosa, Mahavamsa?
items.back: Ashvaghosha, Buddhaghosa, Vasubandhu, Mahanama Thera respectively.
items.examPoint: Buddhist authored works — Ashvaghosha, Buddhaghosa, Vasubandhu, Mahanama Thera

items.front: Jaina: Kalpasutra and Tattvartha Sutra — authors?
items.back: Kalpasutra (& Niryukti) = Bhadrabahu; Tattvartha Sutra = Umaswati (accepted by both sects).

items.front: Arthashastra and Indica — authors and courts?
items.back: Arthashastra = Kautilya (Chanakya); Indica = Megasthenes (Greek envoy at Chandragupta Maurya's court).

items.front: Who wrote the Mudrarakshasa (and its 'sister' drama)?
items.back: Vishakhadatta — Mudrarakshasa (on Chanakya) and the Devichandraguptam.
Tolkappiyam = Tolkappiyar (oldest Tamil grammar); Tirukkural = Thiruvalluvar (1,330 couplets).

items.front: Tamil twin epics and their authors?
items.back: Silappadikaram = Ilango Adigal; Manimekalai = Seethalai Sathanar (Buddhist); Civaka Cintamani = Tirutakkadevar (Jain).
items.examPoint: Sangam epics — Ilango Adigal, Seethalai Sathanar, Tirutakkadevar

items.back: Ramayana = Valmiki (Adi Kavi); Mahabharata (+ Bhagavad Gita + Harivamsa) = Ved Vyasa.
items.examPoint: Gupta epics — Valmiki (Ramayana), Ved Vyasa (Mahabharata, Bhagavad Gita, Harivamsa)

items.back: Abhijnanasakuntalam, Meghaduta, Raghuvamsa, Kumarasambhava, Malavikagnimitram, Vikramorvashiyam.
Shudraka, Vishnu Sharma, Vatsyayana, Amarasimha respectively.
items.examPoint: Gupta prose/drama/lexicon/fables — Shudraka, Dandin, Amarasimha, Vishnu Sharma, Vatsyayana

items.front: Charaka vs Sushruta; Aryabhata vs Brahmagupta?
items.back: Charaka = medicine (Charaka Samhita); Sushruta = surgery. Aryabhata = Aryabhatiya (zero); Brahmagupta = Brahmasphutasiddhanta.
items.examPoint: Gupta science & medicine — Aryabhata, Brahmagupta, Charaka, Sushruta

items.back: Panini — Ashtadhyayi; Katyayana — Vartika; Patanjali — Mahabhashya.
items.examPoint: Grammarians & extra pairs — Panini (Ashtadhyayi), Patanjali (Mahabhashya), Vishakhadatta (Devichandraguptam), Nagarjuna

items.front: Harsha's era: who wrote Harshacharita, and Harsha's own plays?
items.back: Banabhatta — Harshacharita & Kadambari; Harsha himself — Nagananda, Ratnavali, Priyadarsika; Xuanzang — Si-yu-ki.
items.examPoint: Harshavardhana era — Banabhatta, Harsha's own dramas, Xuanzang
